about_the_game:
Introductions

Killing Tragedy Samsara: Ouroboros Reincarnation is a Timeloop Cyberpunk Detective ADV Game. Play the role of the protagonist - teenage novelist Hecate, searching for a way to survive in a lethal detective show with cruel rules. Using timeloop ability, cracking perfect crimes with other competitors, bring the murderer hidden among companions to justice, and discover more secrets about this near-future world.

Features

  • High DOF multi branch narrative - Driving the plot towards another possibility through selection and interaction, even a casual chat with others.

  • Timeloop system - Bring informations of future back to the past, exploring choices which were never imagined.

  • Non-linear Investigation Process - Does the key clue come from a careful investigation of the scene, or from a reassuring witness? Even if there is only one truth, there is not only one way to discover it.

  • Near-future murder case design - Drone, Webcam, Intelligent system - cases constructed with mid-21st century sci-fi elements, suitable for cyber detective methods.

  • Interacting with unique characters - Having conversations with 15 other competitors with distinct personalities, conflicting and understanding each other in a tense atmosphere, uncovering everyone's unknown secrets, and influencing the plot through building interpersonal relationships.

  • Mini games - From calm mind-mapping to restless barrage-attacks, 5 mini games to master at once.

  • Free difficulty adjustment - No need to be afraid of frustrating challenges.

  • Full dynamic Live2D sprites, cinematic shots - Enjoy an immersive storyline experience.

  • Native bilingual support of English/Simplified Chinese.

short_description: A.D.2046 Spring, Hecate, the great novelist, was invited to La Stella Domani Detective Competition, and unexpectedly forced to play a murder game among gifted and criminal teens. With the power of time loop, could she crack those perfect crimes?
